subject.title: fix(tavily): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 own the shared runWebSearch parent-cancellation change, leaving this PR Tavily-specific?
rationale: Both branches carry the same shared invariant, but the SearXNG branch already has positive real held-request proof; selecting the landing owner is a maintainer integration decision.
